summary: Build team trust, speak-up culture, and constructive conflict skills. Enrol in practical psychological safety training for managers and leaders.
lede: Psychological safety and high-trust team training helps team leaders, managers, project professionals and people specialists assess team climate and set speak-up norms. Participants practise using pulse surveys and listening notes, creating team charters and meeting norms, and addressing feedback and conflict through structured conversations. They develop a practical action plan to strengthen trust, accountability and collaboration in their teams.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with teams and now need a more structured approach to trust, candor, and team accountability.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have working experience in leading, coordinating, supporting, or influencing a team. No coding, statistics, or prior psychology training is required, but you should come prepared with a current team challenge, meeting issue, or collaboration problem to use in exercises. Recommended preparation: Bring a recent team meeting agenda, a current feedback challenge, and any team pulse or engagement data available. If your organization uses a survey tool or collaboration platform, that will help you adapt the exercises to your real working environment.
